Daily Devotional

December 23

28 Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law. (Romans 3:28 KJV)

It would seem that most all the religious churches have missed reading this verse, as they seem to want to mix us Christians up by saying we must do works of the law to be right with God. This verse makes it very clear, that we are justified by faith, without any works of the law. Yet most preachers will teach that you are saved by faith in Jesus, but then you must live holy, go to church, tithe, witness, etc. before God will answer your prayers. Why do men always try to put the emphasis on our doing, instead of our believing? I don’t know if preachers think that is the only way to get people to do anything, or what, but if they would teach the love of God instead of works, then they would get more actions out of Christians than condemnation ever will. Jesus said that our rules and traditions make the Word of God of none effect (Mark 7:13) and it is so true. As Jesus said, “If you love me, do as I command” (John 14:15), and our very eternal salvation depends on it (Hebrews 5:9). Our love for Jesus is what will lead us to live holy, as He is holy (1 Peter 1:16).

The true Gospel of Jesus Christ is that you are saved by faith in Him, and nothing else. It is the grace brought to us by Jesus that is the Good News of the Gospel. We are supposed to be entered into the Rest brought by Christ, and if you put works as a requirement, that is not rest. We should live a holy life, but not to get God to bless us, as He already has (Ephesians 1:3), but we should live holy so that our love for God will increase, and it also keeps the devil from putting sickness, poverty, and calamities of all kinds on us (John 10:10). Live holy because you love God, not to get anything from God. If you are truly born again, and have the love of God within you, the desire to live for Jesus will cause you to do works of faith and live holy. Our actions, or fruit, will show if we are truly saved, as a person cannot have Christ living within them, and still want to live in sin. Being born again changes your “want to” from wanting to live for Satan, to wanting to live for Jesus. If you don’t desire to live holy, then you need to get born again, as your desire indicates your salvation or lack thereof.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
